mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PERF_KPI_SCORE (data_date, scheme_code, metric_code, subject_type, subject_id, actual_value, weight, target_value, base_value, score) VALUES (#{dataDate}, #{schemeCode}, #{metricCode}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{actualValue}, #{weight}, #{targetValue}, #{baseValue}, #{score}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE actual_value = VALUES(actual_value), weight = VALUES(weight), target_value = VALUES(target_value), base_value = VALUES(base_value), score = VALUES(score), updated_time = NOW()

sql.if:
AND (
(subject_type = 'ORG' AND subject_id IN #{oc})
OR (subject_type = 'EMP' AND subject_id IN #{ei})
1 = 0
)
